diagnostics.message: "conformance.duplicate.kind" is declared by 2 capabilities (array positions 0, 1). A kind is the catalog's identity for a capability — every projection (KNOWN_INTENT_KINDS, the pack intent mirrors, the planner allowlists) addresses it by that name, so a duplicate silently resolves to whichever entry a consumer happens to reach first.
